approval_conditions: 1 Six S6 agents, arms A and B, three stages of 1M steps; Version 1 preserved; new versions branch from their original checkpoints with complete parent-child history.

2 Rounds 1-3 for learning curves and candidate selection; candidates recorded and locked before round 4; round 4 confirmation only; round 5 replication only; no re-selection from rounds 4-5; failures recorded honestly.
4 Decision-quality score documented and validated before training (docs/decisions/0004).
5 Checkpoint every 250,000 steps; checkpoint, optimizer, exploration, RNG state and history preserved when branching.
6 Frozen: S6 mechanics, rewards, scoring rules, simulator, costs, margin, death threshold, action space, pass/fail criteria; no leverage cap, new penalties, reward or learning-algorithm changes.
7 Arms C and D not approved.
8 Report every agent and version, including failures.

9 Decision-quality score Q2.0 (clamped Kelly) approved by the owner on condition that the mathematics is correct; independent verification passed 36 of 36 checks (reports/phase25/q2_math_verification.md); frozen for S6.

10 Selection: highest mean Q2.0 over rounds 1-3 among versions with median size >= 0.5x; growth seed 1 must also be closer to the growth-optimal size than version 1 (rounds 1-3). Locked before round 4.
11 No trading style is prescribed (decision 0005); agents discover their own approach and position sizing.

arms.A: more training on the original practice market
arms.B: more training on new S6 market paths

compute.estimate: about 2 h 10 min on 4 cores (measured: 12.4 min per 1M-step job with 4 in parallel, 21.5 s per evaluation)
compute.storage: about 80 MB in the repository (checkpoints about 60 MB)

decision_quality.definition: Per decision with net exposure G (position value / equity): s(G) = max(g(G) / g(G*), F), and s(G) = F for a ruinous decision. g(G) = (1 - p) E_Z[ln(1 + G (e^(m + sigma Z) - 1))] + p ln(1 - G J) is the exact expected log growth of holding G for one decision (96-point Gauss-Hermite quadrature; minus infinity if G >= 1/J). G* = argmax g. F = g(G_ruin) / g(G*), the score of the smallest ruinous long position (G_ruin = 0.95 / J in S6; for a market without crashes, the size at which a 5-sigma fall reaches the 5% death line). Ruinous: G >= G_ruin long, or |G| >= 0.95 / (e^(m + 5 sigma) - 1) short. Q2 of an episode = mean of s over its decisions; Q2 of an evaluation = mean of the episode values. Uses only the decisions and the market's known parameters, never realised returns.

frozen: S6 market mechanics, reward functions, scoring rules, simulator, trading costs, margin, death threshold, action space, pass/fail criteria, learning algorithm; no leverage cap, no new penalties. Arms C and D not approved.
selection_rule: Rounds 1-3 only. For each growth seed, among its six continued versions (A1-A3, B1-B3), choose the one with the highest mean Q2.0 over every test run it played in rounds 1-3, among eligible versions. Eligible: mean median position size over those rounds of at least 0.5x; for growth seed 1 also a mean median position size closer (in ratio) to the growth-optimal size than version 1's, both measured over rounds 1-3. If no version is eligible, choose the highest Q2 and record that none was eligible. Ties: lower ruinous share. Recorded and locked (write-once) before round 4; rounds 4 and 5 can never change it.
success_criteria: C1 ruinous decisions fall to at most half of version 1's share, or below 1% (round 4)
C2 decision quality Q2.0 rises: 95% paired-bootstrap interval of (candidate - version 1) over the 20 identical test runs lies above zero (round 4)
C3 median position size at least 0.5x; if version 1's median was below 0.5x, the candidate's median must also be closer (in ratio) to the growth-optimal size (round 4)
C4 replication: C1 and C2 hold again in round 5
Improvement is claimed only if at least 2 of 3 growth seeds meet C1-C4. If the matched controls meet C1 and C2 as often, the improvement is reported as not clearly due to learning from consequences.
